description.value: Smithers Brewing Co. is a timber-framed craft brewery in northern BC, crowned Brewery of the Year at the 2025 Canadian Brewing Awards. Their taproom runs 12 taps with four mainstay beers and five rotating seasonals alongside house-brewed kombucha, nitro cold brew, and BC wines for non-beer drinkers. It is a walk-in-friendly, first-come-first-served space with an outdoor patio that welcomes pets.
